name: ACE EduTrend Ltd
about:
Incorporated in 1993, ACE EduTrend Ltd is
 in the business of IT education and training.[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2]
ACEETL is an IT solutions company specializing in website design, web development, custom PHP & Asp.Net CRM, software development, Android apps, WooCommerce, digital marketing, and blockchain solutions. It also establishes educational and training institutes and acts as consultants, contractors, advisors, surveyors, and liaison agents related to its business operations in India.

pros: Stock is trading at 0.51 times its book value
cons: Company has low interest coverage ratio.
Company has a low return on equity of -3.88% over last 3 years.
